answer: Require each agent to bind its identity to a hardware attestation: a device enclave signs a proof that this key lives on one physical machine, and the proof is anchored to a terrace of checks — one key per device, one device per epoch. A farmer cannot clone the reef of honest devices without buying a thousand real machines, and each marble of silicon costs far more than any single epoch reward. Limit: shared cloud hosts and second-hand hardware need separate handling, so attestation must pair with rate limits.
